research.title: How we took malware advisories beyond npm
research.summary: A compromised package can steal credentials the moment you install it, and until recently, GitHub could only flag those in npm. Not anymore. This is the story of how the supply chain engineering team behind Dependabot expanded malware advisories to eight.

research.title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol and Terra: An evaluation
research.summary: Every model that writes better code hands your team the same bill: more code to check, and less time to check it. That gap between how fast code arrives and how fast a team can verify it is verification debt, and a stronger model does not pay it down. It.
